name: TC-941: a promotion created from a browser already on tomorrow starts on the restaurant's today and is Live
description: Regression for the 10-24 pre-release run (started 03:16 UTC = the evening before in New York): the Create page prefilled the start day from the BROWSER's clock while the backend judges days in the RESTAURANT's zone, so every promotion created that evening showed Scheduled and storefronts did not offer it. Here the owner's browser runs in a zone whose date is already ahead of the restaurant's (Pacific/Kiritimati, UTC+14); Turn on must still land the row Live. Skipped in the hours when no such zone is ahead of the restaurant's date.
